surprises.description: Nautilus was selected for the ARPA-H-funded SEEDS Consortium, which was not flagged in the preview. The company expects to receive up to $6 million over four years for tau and Ewing sarcoma work.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Nautilus was selected for the ARPA-H-funded SEEDS Consortium” and “expects to receive up to $6 million over the 4-year program.”

surprises.description: Three oncology assays reached low median CVs after about a year of development, matching the mature tau assay’s precision much faster than the preview’s discussion of assay cadence and AKT1’s planned Early Access timing would imply. This is encouraging technical evidence beyond the preview’s stated expectations.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Three new oncology assays (AKT1, EGFR, P53) achieved median CVs of 8.8%, 3.6% and 6.6% after only ~1 year of development,” matching the tau assay at 5.5% CV and “beating industry norms near 25%.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview called AKT1’s move into Early Access “the proof that the ‘new assay every few months’ cadence toward ~20 proteoform assays by mid-2028 is real.”

surprises.description: Full-year 2026 revenue is now expected to exceed the approximately $0.5 million prior outlook, rather than merely maintaining it as the preview’s base case assumed. The amount of the expected increase was not specified.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Full-year 2026 revenue now expected to exceed the prior outlook of approximately $0.5 million.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview’s base case said “FY26 revenue ~$0.5M maintained.”

surprises.description: Quarterly operating expenses were $16.9 million, above the preview’s $16.2 million estimate, although below the preview’s $17.5 million level for a notable step-up. This points to somewhat higher spending than forecast, not the larger increase the preview identified as a possible narrative-positive threshold.
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview estimated “Operating expenses $16.2M” and said “a Q3 opex print above ~$17.5M” would be narrative-positive but burn-negative.

surprises.description: Management set a new target to reduce sample-input requirements roughly 100-fold by late 2027, a platform capability goal not discussed in the preview. It could broaden the range of proteins and sample types the platform can measure, though this remains a future target.
surprises.fact_evidence: “The company plans to reduce sample input requirements roughly 100-fold by late 2027, aiming to enable measurement of low-abundance proteins in blood and other biofluids.”
